end.summary:
Named shapes in toys and objects: cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere.
Discussed flat faces, corners, curved surfaces and pointed ends.
Practised identifying a cylinder in different positions; the shape-position mix-up remained.
Teach-back was not passed; 1 of 3 attempts was unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming 3D shapes using toys and everyday objects. Aditya described flat sides, corners, curved surfaces and cone points, and identified cylinder examples such as a candle. There was a mix-up about whether a cylinder changes shape when it is turned or lying down; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, gently turn a can or bottle and ask, “Has its shape changed or only its position?”
